title: Highlights tour
summary: A walk through Tool Hall, Textile Wing and Ceramic Court with a docent.
body: Tours leave from the wall of makers. No tickets beyond museum admission; meet at the desk.

title: Chalk line demo
summary: Snap a chalk line and talk about how The Measured Hand was installed.
body: Part of the Saturday demo series. Safe for families; kids can try a short line on scrap.

title: Thursday weaving
summary: Watch or try a few picks on the floor loom.
body: A staff weaver warps ahead of time. Visitors take turns under guidance.

title: Clay talk for schools
summary: A twenty-minute talk on kilns and molds for school groups.
body: Teachers book through the school desk in Entry Hall. Packets for teachers are members-adjacent; public schools get a paper copy at the desk.

title: Maker talk: Open Bench
when_label: First Friday of the month, 6 pm
summary: The season's makers talk about what is unfinished on their benches.
body: Standing room along the rail. Members may reserve a front spot in the members room.

title: Member preview: School of the Hand
summary: Members see the apprenticeship show before it opens.
body: Sign in to the members room for the preview note and checklist.

title: Family Sunday: measure and make
summary: Simple measuring games and a take-home paper rule.
body: Free with admission. Supplies at the school desk.

title: Docent briefing
summary: Weekly briefing on new labels, loan returns and tour routes.
body: Staff only. Notes appear in the staff room packet list.

title: Loan intake walkthrough
summary: How to check a loan crate against the checklist.

title: Members' evening in the Vault
summary: Members book a reading table and request objects from storage.
body: Request form is in the members room. No public booking on this site.

title: Pattern book handling
summary: How to request and handle pattern books in the Study Vault.

title: River Walk approach
summary: A short outdoor talk on how goods reached the museum site from the river.
body: Meet at the ramp. Cancelled in hard rain; check the journal.
